summary.en: College/indie guitar rock that became the nineties mainstream category.
summary.zh: 学院/独立吉他摇滚，后来成为 90 年代主流分类。

body.en: Alternative starts as a college-radio and indie-press category, then becomes default rock on MTV and modern-rock radio. It covers Radiohead-style album evolution and the scattered streams after Grunge.
body.zh: Alternative 起初是学院电台与独立媒体分类，后来成为 MTV 与现代摇滚电台的默认摇滚。它覆盖 Radiohead 式专辑演进，也承接 Grunge 之后的散落支流。
